venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Closed (Sunday).** CC Atlanta does not operate on Sundays; no EON report is expected. Dark day, not an outstanding report.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Warm, not too hot; scattered rain
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 7/26.** MOD KE. Net $1,210 vs target $1,580 (-23.4%); food $6, comps $17 (1.4%). 48 guests, $25.21 check avg. Chill but good night — new faces including industry folks new to the space who'll likely return; at least one birthday party and four date nights. 86 NA beer (incoming this week). MAINTENANCE FLAG: flooding in the kitchen. Favorite moment: a commissioned pet portrait surprise — she cried.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 7/26.** AM MOD Maggie H; PM Carey. Total net $11,382.70 vs target $9,905 (+14.9%), incl. events $11,456.86; D&C PM $9,563.66, DC/AM $1,819.04, Garden/6A $2,468.30, net event sales $250.29, food $2,422. 212 guests (Tock), comps $551.50 (4.81%). Slowest night of UMS — Vauxhall had no foot traffic after 7pm so the bar shut early; Garden & Lobby stayed active with early cuts as street energy dropped. Renfest crew came in deep and styled out the Garden. Conference and Telegraph batches stocked. No-shows charged. A successful UMS weekend overall.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 7/26.** MOD Kyler. Net $3,686 vs target $3,823 (-3.6%); beverage $3,508, food $178; comps $67.15. 114 covers, $32 check avg. Strong open with a massive crush ~8pm, then a lull and slow flow, dying out at midnight. 11/10 service to squeeze second rounds; lots of neighborhood day-trippers (FiDi, midtown, Park Slope) and book-inspired visits. Two Colorado groups who know the Denver location visited EV for the first time. One no-show 4-top. Top sellers: Shinebox, chips & dip, Cloudwalk / High Plains Drifter (tie).

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 7/26.** MOD Joe + Josh + Oscar. Net $4,679 vs target $4,893 (-4.4%); all Marquee (SR closed); food $679; comps $83.50 (investors, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL). 127 guests. Wonderful Sunday — 33 covers on the books, steady walk-ins from open, bar top full of enthusiastic D&C fans spoiled with compendium drinks. Very busy 9-10pm with big walk-in parties; waitlist hit 20 at one point, team burned and turned all night. A group of questionable characters left on their own after realizing there was no dance floor. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: Jorge's EON quesadillas.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 7/26.** MOD Josh. Net $1,748.78 vs target $1,905 (-8.2%); Marquee $2,221.11 gross, Garden closed, food $104; comps $22 (1.2%). 41 guests. Very light Sunday with few reservations or walk-ins; smooth service with the team focused on details and guest connection. Downtime used well: reset the space, cleaned windows, ABK projects, and a head start juicing for Monday. Maintenance: call Orkin. Favorite moment: eight Amalfi Spiders going out at once.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 7/26.** AM MOD Sam & Lex; PM Braden & Marcus. Net $7,025 vs target $6,500 (+8.1%); Municipal AM $1,956, PM $3,466, Sun Club $346, Hot Eye $1,214; food $2,227; comps $159. Guests 171 (78 AM / 93 PM). Quiet breakfast with some IRD, decent lunch push 12-2. Slow evening with a 9:45 pop and a fun bachelorette; Sam B and Catie ran a smooth duo service. Hot Eye: bar crawl at 9, then a large 11pm birthday party plus industry pop — business concentrated in the last two hours. Kitchen note: cooler unplugged overnight to thaw, must be re-plugged in the morning.
